name: Minecraft: Modpack
description: Deploy any Modrinth modpack as a server — pick the pack, pick a version, and the panel installs the right loader, every mod and the pack's own configs. Fabric, Quilt, NeoForge and Forge packs are all supported.

wizard.title: Choose a modpack
wizard.description: Anything on Modrinth with a server-installable release. The list shows the most downloaded packs — start typing to jump to one.

wizard.title: Server settings
wizard.description: Modpacks are heavy: give it 6 GB or more, and expect the first start to take several minutes while it generates the world.

variables.name: MODPACK
variables.label: Modpack
variables.description: Or choose Custom… and paste a Modrinth project slug, e.g. 'fabulously-optimized'.

variables.name: MODPACK_VERSION
variables.label: Pack version
variables.description: The newest release is picked for you.

variables.name: JAVA_ARGS
variables.label: Extra JVM flags
variables.description: Applied on top of the memory limit.

install.label: Install the Java the pack needs
Fetch {{PACK_NAME}} and unpack its configs
install.run:
gp_log "{{PACK_NAME}} · Minecraft {{PACK_MC_VERSION}} · {{PACK_LOADER}}"
gp_fetch "{{DOWNLOAD_URL}}" pack.mrpack
gp_have unzip || gp_apt unzip
rm -rf .packtmp && mkdir -p .packtmp
unzip -oq pack.mrpack -d .packtmp || gp_die "Could not unpack the modpack"
# 'overrides' holds the pack's own configs and scripts; the server-only
# variant wins where both exist.
if [ -d .packtmp/overrides ]; then cp -rf .packtmp/overrides/. .; fi
if [ -d .packtmp/server-overrides ]; then cp -rf .packtmp/server-overrides/. .; fi
rm -rf .packtmp pack.mrpack
mkdir -p mods

install.content:
# Accepted through GamePanel on install
eula=true
